acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I have entered accounts, income, and expenses When I navigate to the Data Entry page Then I see a summary panel showing: Total Debt (sum of all account balances ZAR), Total Monthly Income (sum of all income ZAR), Total Monthly Expenses (sum of all expenses ZAR), Minimum Debt Payments (sum of all minimum payments ZAR), Available Surplus (Income - Expenses - Minimum Payments ZAR), Number of Accounts (Count)
Given Available Surplus is negative When I view the snapshot Then the surplus shows in red with warning icon
Given Available Surplus is positive When I view the snapshot Then the surplus shows in green
Given I make changes to any data (accounts, income, expenses) When I return to the snapshot view Then all totals update automatically (reactive via Dexie useLiveQuery)
Given I have no accounts, income, or expenses entered When I view the snapshot Then I see zeros for all values with helpful messaging to add data
Given I have a flexi facility When I view the snapshot Then I see an indicator showing flexi facility status (available credit)

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Dexie.js for IndexedDB persistence with React hooks (useLiveQuery), big.js for precision financial calculations, Zustand for UI state. Component location: src/components/accounts/.

doc.snippet: FR6: User can view complete financial snapshot showing all accounts, current balances, and total debt. NFR-P2: Form inputs respond immediately to user interaction (< 100ms).
